rater: B (geometry and proportion first), round w2 on commit c7ad1fa

details.detail: Planform, raked tip and cruise bending. Unchanged since w1. The seat-for-seat checks still hold: the 11A inlet sits 11.6 deg forward of the beam (photo about 11.5); the 26K tip sits 5.0 deg above horizontal (photo about 4.7). The right side (d_17K, d_26K, d_30K) mirrors the left correctly, and the tip rises just above the horizon as in _7282.

JA795A registration on the right upper wing. My w1 'upside down' call was wrong: zoomed, _7345 and _7331 read upright left to right, J inboard, glyph tops toward the leading edge. The build matches this (o_reg), and the span range s 13.5-20 matches the photos. Remaining problem: the chordwise position. From 26K (d_26K) and 17K the glyph tops touch the leading-edge silhouette. In _7345 and _7331 there is a clear band of skin, about one foreshortened glyph height, between the LE silhouette and the glyph tops, and the text bottoms sit just above the double line (spoiler/rear-spar line). At 33 % chord the text sits on the airfoil crest, where it foreshortens into the silhouette from the seated eye (about 1.15 m, below the crest at s 16).
Canoe count and positions. The outboard pair is now at s 14.7 and 20.4. From 26K the outer canoe tail lands inboard of the aileron notch, as in _7331.

Canoe shape. The tails now taper, and the d_26K silhouette is close to _7331. There is a visible notch in the lower profile about 90 % along each canoe (d_26K, k_canoe_side), where Math.pow(c, 0.5) hits the 0.4 depth floor and the slope jumps. There is a second small step where the 0.42*e end cap begins. The real tails taper smoothly into the rounded end.

Canoe tone. On the K side (sun side) the lit flank is #ced1d3, against #d3d6d3 in _7331; the wing is #afb4ba (photo #c0ccd4). This matches. On the A side (shade side) the canoes are #5c6678 against a #a6acb3 wing, a ratio of 0.55. _7329 on the shade side gives #3b444e against #abb2b9, a ratio of 0.35, so dark canoes on the shade side are correct. At sunset on the sun side (s_26A) the flanks are cream #d0bc96, brighter than the wing (#8e7167). This is physically plausible (low sun on vertical flanks, grazing on the upper skin) but looks too yellow. Deck bounce is handed to lighting.
Gear stripe: 0.46 m wide, #2a2e33 in d_17A and d_17K. It matches F-GSQR_1 and _7242.

Skin seams, panel tone and static dischargers. The faint spanwise splice and chordwise butt joints read right from 26K (compare _7250/_7331). The ±3 % panel tone is subtle and does not alias. The dischargers are present on the aileron and raked-tip trailing edges (j_tip) and read as a fine comb from 30K.

GE90 nacelle. The strake and access panel are present and the strake's inclination is right (aft end higher, as in B-KQZ_074140). Two problems. (1) Strake station: in B-KQZ_074140 the strake lies entirely inside the middle cowl panel and ends just ahead of the aft split line. The model centres it at 3.05 m, so it spans 2.40-3.70 m and crosses the 3.15 m split. (2) On the sun side the cowl is flat, clipped white: #e8edf0 in d_13K and #e9eef0 in d_11K, with the split lines and hump almost invisible. The photos give #9fabb7 (Leaving_Sri_Lanka), #919191 (GE90_14450613805) and #a9c0ce (B-KQZ), with a clear top-to-side gradient. The A side (#b5c4d3) is fine.

Pylon. It is now broad and low, starts aft of the inlet and rises into a saddle under the LE, as in lalf_137. Two problems. (1) It renders brighter than the cowl it sits on (#dfe5e8 against #b5c4d3 in d_13A): the x1.6 pylon flank fill loop (from vP) now also brightens the cowl-white forward fairing. In lalf_137 the hump is the same tone as the cowl or slightly darker. (2) From 13A and in m_pylon it reads as a faceted tent with a sharp crease. Over the forward cowl the section is 1.2 m wide but only about 0.33 m deep, so r = w*0.48 (0.58) exceeds d/2 and the rounded-box section degenerates.
Nav lights. Brighter and readable as a point at the tip (d_33A, n_17A); _7282 shows a star point with glow.
Day sky (owner: lighting). Unchanged: pale #bdccdc at the top against #527dc2 in _7282 and #4d7098 in F-GSQR.
Sunset (owner: lighting). s_26K on the shade side has a cool, dark wing, which matches _7282. s_26A/s_17A on the sun side are warm brown, which is plausible for the sun side.
Night (owner: lighting for the beacon and ambient). The wing is a dark silhouette with the nav light (n_17A, n_26K); the stripe is still faintly legible.

issues.problem: Registration sits on the airfoil crest and merges into the leading-edge silhouette from the K seats
issues.detail: In d_26K and d_17K the glyph tops touch the LE silhouette. In the photos a skin band about one glyph high separates them, and the text bottoms sit just above the spoiler line.
issues.fix: In buildExterior's registration loop change xc = lef(sC + 0.45) + 0.33 * (...) to 0.50 * (...). The ink then spans about 40-60 % chord, still clear of the spoiler front at te - 1.4 (about 78 %).

issues.problem: Pylon forward fairing is brighter than the cowl and faceted into a tent
issues.detail: The flank fill is applied to the cowl-white fairing, and the corner radius exceeds half the section depth over the forward cowl.
issues.evidence: d_13A: pylon #dfe5e8 against cowl #b5c4d3. lalf_ANA77W_NH212_137: the hump is the same tone as the cowl. m_pylon shows the sharp crease.
issues.fix: (a) Record const vS = B.vcount just before the strut B.add(gLoft(secs.slice(kLE), ...), paint) and run the x1.6 pylon flank-fill loop from vS instead of vP. (b) In the pylon section push, set r: Math.min(w * 0.48, (top - bot) * 0.45).

issues.problem: Sun-side cowl clips to flat white
issues.detail: The K-side cowl is #e8edf0 with no gradient; the split lines and hump vanish.
issues.fix: Set the cowl material to { c: '#d6d9dd', r: 0.25, m: 0.15 }. If the K side still clips, ask lighting (owner: lighting) for exterior exposure headroom.

issues.problem: Canoe tail has a profile notch at the depth-floor transition
issues.detail: Math.max(0.4, Math.pow(c, 0.5)) and Math.max(0.5, Math.pow(c, 0.4)) create a slope break at about 90 %, and the end cap starts at 0.42*e against a 0.40 floor.
issues.fix: Replace the floors with smooth blends: rw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.pow(c, 0.6), rd = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.pow(c, 0.7) for t >= 0.22. Change the end cap to sec(x1 + u * RE, 0.5 * e, 0.4 * e) so it continues without a step.

issues.problem: Strake straddles the aft cowl split line
issues.detail: Photos show the strake inside the middle cowl panel, ending just ahead of the aft split.
issues.evidence: B-KQZ_right_engine_20251029-074140 (strake x 1100-1360, split about x 1400); Leaving_Sri_Lanka_(2476362502).
issues.fix: In the strake M4.trs change the station 3.05 -> 2.45 (spanning 1.80-3.10, ahead of the 3.15 split).
